description:
Find freelance opportunities that fit your skills and budget. EarlyBird brings the job matches and alert preferences from your EarlyBird account into ChatGPT.

Explore recent Upwork jobs, ask for a daily shortlist, and compare fixed-price budgets and hourly rates separately. Review job details and links before deciding where to apply. Update your saved skills, minimum budgets, and email alert preferences through conversation.

Connect an existing EarlyBird account to use this plugin. Telegram and Slack connections are managed on the EarlyBird website. EarlyBird does not submit applications or guarantee interviews or work. EarlyBird is an independent service, not affiliated with or endorsed by Upwork.

defaultPrompt: Show my latest matching Upwork jobs.
Compare my top fixed-price and hourly opportunities from the last week.
What skills and minimum budgets are saved in my job alerts?
